title: Winmate HotTab Exposed Dangerous Function Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-118630)
description: CVE-2026-118630 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the HotTab driver of Winmate devices. It allows an attacker with low-privileged code execution on the device to escalate privileges to kernel level and execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability arises from an exposed dangerous function in the driver. No specific affected versions or patches are currently documented.
